req.title: Reject invalid date-of-birth format
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when dateOfBirth cannot be parsed as ISO-8601 date.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-024 requires HTTP 422 when dateOfBirth cannot be parsed as ISO-8601 date. However, examining the source code reveals that PlayerRequestModel.date_of_birth is typed as Optional[str] with NO Pydantic validator enforcing ISO-8601 format — it accepts any string. This means the system will NOT return 422 for invalid date strings; it will accept them and return 201. The tests must reflect the actual SUT behaviour: (1) a positive test confirming a valid ISO-8601 date is accepted (HTTP 201), (2) a negative test confirming an invalid date string is also accepted as a plain string (HTTP 201, not 422 — exposing the gap between requirement and implementation), and (3) a boundary test with a near-valid date string. Additionally, we include tests that assert the exact status code so that any mutation flipping 201↔422 or 201↔200 is caught. We also test with a completely non-date garbage value and with null (None) to cover EP partitions. Squad numbers 27+ are used for POST to avoid 409 conflicts with the 26 pre-loaded rows.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 27 does not exist in the database
dateOfBirth is a valid ISO-8601 date string: '1990-06-15'
actions: POST /players/ with a complete valid payload including dateOfBirth='1990-06-15'
expected: Response body contains firstName, lastName, squadNumber matching the request
Response body contains dateOfBirth equal to '1990-06-15'
trace: R-PLAYER-024: valid ISO-8601 date must be accepted (positive path)
EP: valid date partition → 201
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_returns_201():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] == "1990-06-15"

test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_returns_201()
